regime_context: The policy regime is a stagflationary split: Warsh is holding a hawkish, inflation-first line (Sept hike is now majority-priced) while Bessent structurally suppresses the front end via bill-heavy issuance and buybacks. The consensus narrative treats Fed and Treasury as fully coordinated; revealed interest is aligned-incentives only — hawkish Fed credibility actually helps Treasury's low-rate funding math, so easing stays inflation-gated optionality post-midterm.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制处于滞胀分裂状态：Warsh 坚持鹰派、通胀优先的立场（9月加息已成为主流定价），而 Bessent 通过以短债为主的发行和回购在结构上压低短端利率。市场共识把美联储和财政部视为完全协同；但揭示出来的利益只是激励一致——鹰派美联储的可信度实际上有助于财政部的低利率融资算术，因此宽松仍是受通胀门槛约束的中期选举后期权。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh's revealed preference is inflation-mandate first; with core PCE at 3.4% y/y and the Sept hike priced >70%, front-end pressure and term-premium bleed into long-duration. Bessent's bill-heavy issuance keeps the belly anchored but leaves the long end exposed to a credible hawkish Fed.
theses.thesis_zh: Warsh 的显性偏好是通胀使命优先；核心 PCE 同比 3.4%，且 9 月加息定价超过 70%，短端压力和期限溢价渗入长久期。Bessent 以短债为主的发行锚定中段，但让长端暴露于可信的鹰派美联储。
evidence: May PCE core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y (highest since Oct-2023); headline 4.1% y/y
CME FedWatch >70% Sept hike probability (50.6% 25bp + 19.6% 50bp)
Warsh Sintra: 'prices are too high', declined to signal July, buried forward guidance
Fed_path_gap: market more hawkish than the Fed (market 3.96 vs dot 3.8)
theses.dissent: If June's +57k payrolls crack widens and the labor leg forces a data-driven September pivot, the entire front end reprices lower and long duration rips higher.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果 6 月 +57k 的就业数据裂缝扩大，劳动力这一端迫使美联储基于数据在 9 月转向宽松，整个短端将重新向下定价，长久期将大幅上涨。

falsifier.text: TLT beats SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: TLT 在检查日之前跑赢 SPY 5%

theses.subject: XLF
theses.thesis: A hiking-majority Fed steepens the near end while Bessent's dealer-intermediation reform and T-bill supply hand dealer banks a widening carry and repo-adjacent fee pool. Banks gain directly from the hawkish-credibility phase without needing a single cut.
theses.thesis_zh: 加息占多数的美联储使近端曲线变陡，而 Bessent 的交易商中介改革和短债供应为交易商银行提供了扩大的利差收入和与回购相关的费用池。银行无需一次降息就能从鹰派可信度阶段直接获益。
evidence: Treasury dealer-intermediation reform (FACT mechanism)
Bill-heavy issuance + buybacks as explicit yield suppression (FACT)
Fed_path_gap: market more hawkish than the Fed — front-end steepening pressure
Financials / dealer banks flagged as targeted rotation with XLF, KBE proxies
theses.dissent: If the labor crack deepens and a September cut lands, front-end steepening reverses into bull-flattening and the dealer carry compresses before the reform revenue is banked.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果劳动力裂缝加深且 9 月降息落地，近端陡峭化将逆转为牛平，交易商利差收入在改革收益入账前就被压缩。

falsifier.text: XLF lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: XLF 在检查日之前跑输 SPY 5%

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse is a realized supply shock with Brent spiking to ~$80 intraday. Energy was the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 and the rotation is now re-primed; the administration's strategic posture (defense, Hormuz risk) keeps the oil risk premium bid regardless of tariff politics.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂是已实现的供给冲击，布伦特原油盘中飙升至约 80 美元。能源板块是 Q1 资金流入最多的 ETF 板块，轮动现已重新点燃；无论关税政治如何，政府的战略姿态（国防、霍尔木兹海峡风险）都维持油价风险溢价。
evidence: Iran ceasefire collapse declared over 7/8; US strikes 7/8–11; Brent ~$80 intraday (FACT)
Energy top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 on the conflict (FACT)
Theater: Oil two-sided but upside-skewed on headlines; rotation real and re-primed
Track record: two consecutive XLE overweight hits (7/25 and 8/1)
theses.dissent: A rapid diplomatic de-escalation or Hormuz transit normalizing would pull the supply premium out fast; XLE is headline-fragile and the prior conflict bid can unwind in days.
theses.dissent_zh: 快速的外交降级或霍尔木兹海峡航运恢复正常，供给溢价会迅速消失；XLE 对消息面高度敏感，此前的冲突买盘可能在数日内解除。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: XLE 在检查日之前跑输 SPY 5%

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: Gold is caught between two real-yield regimes: a hawkish Fed pushing realized real yields higher (gold-bearish) and an oil-shock stagflation tail supporting haven demand (gold-bullish). With the Sept hike majority-priced and gold already trading $4,044–4,200, the two forces roughly cancel with high headline variance.
theses.thesis_zh: 黄金被困在两种实际利率体制之间：鹰派美联储推高已实现的实际利率（利空黄金），而石油冲击的滞胀尾部支撑避险需求（利好黄金）。在 9 月加息已获主流定价、黄金已在 4,044–4,200 美元区间交易的情况下，两种力量大致抵消且消息面方差很高。
evidence: Real 10y at 2.29% in staging phase; Sept hike >70% priced
Gold trading $4,044–4,200 range (FACT)
Track record: GLD underweight miss, realized +11.19% vs the lean
Mar-a-Lago dollar-bearish turn is a THEORY tail, not ownable policy
theses.dissent: If the oil shock forces a dovish offset despite hot PCE, or a Mar-a-Lago turn materializes, real yields fall and gold breaks out decisively.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果石油冲击迫使美联储在 PCE 高企的情况下做出鸽派对冲，或者 Mar-a-Lago 转向成为现实，实际利率下降，黄金将决定性突破。

falsifier.text: GLD beats SPY by 10% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: GLD 在检查日之前跑赢 SPY 10%

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI is the administration's cleanest industrial-policy lever: HALEU fuel-bank releases and AI-reactor siting are contracted, visible steps that don't depend on court rulings or tariff handoffs. The capital-rotation map flags nuclear as highest-confidence among re-industrialization themes and OKLO is the direct AI-datacenter reactor proxy.
theses.thesis_zh: 核能驱动 AI 是政府最清晰的产业政策杠杆：HALEU 燃料库释放和 AI 反应堆选址是有合同支撑、可见的举措，不依赖法院裁决或关税交接。资金轮动图将核能列为再工业化主题中置信度最高的方向，OKLO 是直接的 AI 数据中心反应堆标的。
evidence: Nuclear-for-AI is a FACT mechanism with DOE HALEU fuel-bank release as an open prediction
OKLO listed among nuclear proxies (URA, URNM, NLR, SMR, OKLO, CCJ, LEU)
Industrial policy steers capital toward strategic domestic capacity (thesis)
Does not depend on Section 301 handoff or ceasefire fragility
theses.dissent: Nuclear is a high-duration, discretionary-spending theme; a broad risk-off from the stagflation split or a defense-budget crowding-out hits unprofitable reactor developers hardest before any DOE contracts translate to revenue.
theses.dissent_zh: 核能是高久期、依赖自由裁量支出的主题；滞胀分裂引发的广泛避险或国防预算的挤出效应，会在任何 DOE 合同转化为收入之前，对尚未盈利的反应堆开发商打击最重。

falsifier.text: OKLO lags SPY by 15% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: OKLO 在检查日之前跑输 SPY 15%
